messages.subject: Stratton MSA – Schedules 2 and 3 (SLA and DPA)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Ahead of the call, a couple of points on the schedules. Schedule 2: we've set service credits at 5% / 10% / 20% against an availability floor, with a right to terminate after three consecutive failed months – I think that meets Stratton's reporting concern. Schedule 3: Caspian hosts in the UK but uses two EEA sub-processors; we'll list them and give 30 days' notice of any change, with appropriate safeguards.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
